blocks.text: As parols began to brighten neighborhoods for the Christmas season, Greenfield Development Corporation invited families, friends, and communities to a weekend of events that kicked off this year’s holiday celebrations. The festivities began with “Christmas for Generations” at Greenfield District in Mandaluyong on November 6 and continued with “Pasko sa Paseo” at Paseo Outlets, Greenfield City, Sta. Rosa, Laguna on November 7. For many, the annual tree lighting at Greenfield District’s Central Park in Mandaluyong has become a familiar holiday tradition that marks the beginning of the Christmas season.
